<thought>We have six observed 13C NMR chemical shifts: 168.60, 143.85, 130.30, 22.80, 21.35, 19.20 ppm. I will simulate the 13C NMR spectrum for each candidate SMILES returned earlier and compare the simulated carbon shift values to the observed ones. The candidate whose simulated shifts best match the observed set will be the correct structure, and I will output its SMILES.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CCON1C=CCN1"}</action_input>
